fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/session: Resolve on a hook blocked/permission report at T with a Rex idle report at T+1s gives idle from Rex, with a Rex report at T-1s or a Rex blocked report gives the hook's blocked, and a hook blocked/question at T with Rex idle at T+1s stays blocked; session-message.txtar (or a new session-message-permission.txtar) sends to a session with a hook blocked/permission report and a newer Rex idle report and the pointer is typed once, then Enter
fields.statement: A session blocked on a permission prompt stops resolving as blocked once a Rex report newer than that hook report says it is idle or working; question and auth blocks keep strict hook precedence, and with no newer report the block stands

fields.acceptance: A new inbox-permission.txtar: a live run journal whose current step's session record has a hook blocked/permission report with a detail message gives one item of kind permission in rhiza inbox --json (session, run, step, detail, tab, next naming rhiza inbox open) in both an owner-run and an autonomous run, none once a newer Rex idle report is recorded, and an autonomous run's question block still gives none; inbox-stalled.txtar still passes; the web inbox test in ./internal/web shows the permission item with its label
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists each session of a live run that resolves as blocked on a permission prompt as an item of kind permission as soon as it blocks, in autonomous runs too, naming the run, step, session, the prompt's message and its tab, with rhiza inbox open <item> as the next step to answer it there; the notify hook, the inbox app and the web UI show it like the other kinds, and autonomous runs still list no questions

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestSessionMessage: a session blocked on a permission prompt gets one stderr line naming the kind, the detail and rhiza inbox open, a new line only when the status changes to working, and a timeout error naming the last status; the session-message testscripts still pass with stdout and --json unchanged
fields.statement: While rhiza session message waits for a session's prompt it prints to stderr why it waits, once at the start and again whenever the resolved status changes: for a blocked session the block's kind and detail and how to answer it (rhiza inbox open), for a working or starting one that it is working, each with the timeout; the timeout error names the last status, and the JSON output and the 10m default are unchanged
